snippet.title: Dead Against Us (Teaser)
snippet.description:
Dead Against Us is an unforgiving top-down zombie shooter. Each day is a fight for survival. Scavenge the map for weapons and complete simple tasks to advance to the next level. How long will you last?

You can get it here: https://bitvice.itch.io/dead-against-us
